descriptions.inProgress: Romeo was able to complete the making of Snowfield Rose, but he's terribly shy. So shy that he was too terrified to give the flower to #bJuliet#k himself, and asked me to deliver the flower to her for him. I didn't know he was like this...
descriptions.completed: I gave Juliet Romeo's flower. Thankfully, she seemed very satisfied with the choice of the present. Good thing he didn't give her something like a Scorpion Needle.
